# Southwest Industrial

> Industrial supply distributor in Flagstaff, Arizona, serving Northern Arizona since 2000. Founded by Brent.

- Address: 1709 N East St, Flagstaff, AZ 86004
- Phone: 928-522-9296
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday. Emergency orders by phone after hours.
- Email: Brent@southwest-industrial.com, Caleb@southwest-industrial.com

## Products
Bearings and linear motion; mechanical power transmission; conveyor belting and components; motors, AC drives/VFDs and soft starters; hydraulic, pneumatic and industrial hose and fittings; industrial MRO supplies.

## Services
Same-day quotes on standard items, emergency and rush orders, hard-to-find and obsolete part sourcing, technical and application support, inventory and stocking programs, on-site consultation.

## Industries
Manufacturing, mining and aggregates, forestry and lumber, food and beverage, transportation, public works.
